commands.description: Estrazione puntuale: identifica entità e concetti chiave. Per ogni elemento, riporta la citazione testuale esatta (verbatim) e spiega perché è rilevante.
Sintesi densa: elimina ripetizioni e dettagli minori. Mantieni solo i punti informativi essenziali e i passaggi decisivi.
Filtro tematico: isola e raggruppa solo le parti del testo che trattano l'argomento specifico indicato.
Analisi strutturale: individua ed estrai le singole tesi, argomentazioni o catene di ragionamento presenti.
Comparazione: analizza due o più elementi evidenziando in modo preciso somiglianze, differenze e punti di contatto.
Fusione dati: unisci più testi in un unico output coerente, eliminando i doppioni e risolvendo eventuali contrasti tra le informazioni.
Task libero: esegui qualsiasi altra operazione richiesta non specificata sopra.

sources.name: legal_case
sources.description: Documentation relating to legal proceedings and rulings. This includes the identification and profile of the parties involved (judge, plaintiff, defendant/defendant, their respective attorneys, status, and nationality), chronological details (year of hearing and trial), the legal framework (type of case, charges, number of regulations and precedents cited, admission of evidence), and the formal outcome of the proceedings (verdict, level of judgment, fines, and apportionment of legal fees).

what.name: judge_name
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "name of the judge presiding over the case (e.g., arshall J.)"

what.name: plaintiff
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "name of the first person or entity who initiates a lawsuit or legal action(if there are multiple plaintiffs, extract only the first one mentioned; e.g., Cairnsmore Holdings Pty Ltd)"

what.name: defendant
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "name of the first person or entity being sued or accused (if there are multiple defendants, extract only the first one mentioned; e.g., Narnia Investments Pty Ltd)"

what.name: hearing_year
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "year when the hearing began; use format YYYY (e.g., 2009)"

what.name: judgment_year
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "year when the judgment was delivered; use format YYYY (e.g., 2009)"

what.name: charges
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "list of specific legal accusations or charges brought against the defendant (e.g., misleading conduct; price fixing; use a semicolon to separate multiple charges; leave empty if not applicable)"

what.name: case_type
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "type of the case, choose one from [Criminal Case, Civil Case, Commercial Case, Administrative Case]; (e.g., Criminal Case)"

what.name: verdict
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "court's decision, choose one from: [Guilty, Not Guilty, Others, Dismissed, Approved]; (e.g., Guilty)"

what.name: legal_basis_num
what.definition: A "int" element with the following description "Number of distinct legal statutes or codes cited in the judgment (e.g., 'Trade Practices Act 1974' counts as 1; enter an integer, e.g., 1)"

what.name: case_number
what.definition: A "int" element with the following description "Number of distinct precedent cases referenced in the judgment, including those cited, considered, discussed, or applied (e.g., 'Australian Competition and Consumer Commission v Rana' counts as 1; enter an integer, e.g., 1)"

what.name: counsel_for_applicant
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "name of the applicant’s lawyer (e.g., Mr I Faulkner SC)"

what.name: counsel_for_respondent
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "name of the respondent’s lawyer (e.g., Mr D Barclay)"

what.name: nationality_for_applicant
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "applicant’s nationality (e.g., Australia)"

what.name: fine_amount
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "total monetary amount of fines imposed in the case (include all fines, partial payments, and fines for multiple parties; leave empty if none; e.g., 250000)"

what.name: legal_fees
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "total amount of legal fees awarded or imposed (sum all applicable fees; leave empty if none; e.g., 30000)"

what.name: plaintiff_current_status
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "current occupation or type of the plaintiff (if an individual, write occupation; if multiple people, use the first individual's occupation; if an organization, write 'organization'; if a company, write 'company'; if a government body, write 'government'; leave empty if unknown; e.g., company)"

what.name: defendant_current_status
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "current occupation or type of the defendant (rules same as for plaintiff; e.g., government)"

what.name: evidence
what.definition: A "int" element with the following description "whether evidence was provided (1 if yes, 0 if none; e.g., 1)"

what.name: first_judge
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "whether it was the first judgment (1 if yes, 0 if none; e.g., 1)"
